adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework recovered the Table 1 MIC/MBC matrix, reconciled linked database assay rows to primary Table 1 values, preserved the LfcinB sequence discrepancy and CAMP aggregate-row conflicts, and bounded mechanism claims to phenotype/context evidence.

materials_exhausted.supplementary_assets: no supplementary assets listed in packet/OA package; supplementary_index and supplementary_tables checked

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay/literature rows were source-reviewed against Table 1/article metadata. Rows with exact Table 1 value matches are verified except the LfcinB sequence-key rows, where the paper-local Introduction/Table-footnote sequence discrepancy is preserved as source_conflict. CAMP aggregate rows with non-current-paper targets remain conflict/database-only cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Table 1 supports 48 MIC/MBC records across 8 entities, 3 strains, and 2 endpoints with µg/mL plus parenthetical µM preserved. Hemolysis is recorded only as qualitative no-hemolysis context because exact numeric percentages are not reported locally.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: The current paper supports antibacterial phenotype activity and CD structural context. Prior membrane-permeability mechanism text is retained as literature context only, not direct mechanism evidence.

caution_findings.evidence_context: The paper-local Introduction and Table 1 footnote disagree on the terminal residue of LfcinB; database rows for DBAASPR_1361 remain source_conflict while Table 1 activity values are retained.
CAMP aggregate rows include activity annotations beyond the three Table 1 strains; those rows are not promoted to source_verified.
The local article states no hemolytic activity at 50-200 µg/mL but does not provide per-peptide numeric hemolysis percentages.
